policy: Unchanged v3 nearest-title-passage runbook selection, Mechanism then Checks, existing source/context bounds
controls: Replay archived v3 runbook 0.30 and body lexical OR for all 12 development cases before opening held-out inputs. Require pinned raw/hash helpers and exact input/query/source metadata/ranks; distance tolerance 0.000001. Preserve protocol and runner hashes before first held-out access.

confirmation_gate.minimum_mrr: lexical OR on held-out nonempty relevance cases

scoring: Original frozen annotations, Precision@3 denominator three, relevance metrics over nonempty relevance sets. Load annotations only after all retrieval. No relabeling or substitutions.
stop: One held-out pass, fixed cutoff/policy. Preserve failed or partial reports. Any failed gate prevents runtime promotion. No further tuning on these now-inspected cases; future tuning requires a fresh held-out set.
promotion: Conditional only: successful retrieval confirmation permits a separately verified runtime integration increment, not an LLM-quality claim or live evaluation authorization.
limits: Live generation requires separate bounded approval
